manol: mano + le — hand + to him (enclitic le reduced to l)
besada: besar — kissed (past part. fem., agreeing with mano; ha besada = 'has kissed')
cinxiestes: çeñir — you girded (strong preterite 2nd pl., respectful to one person; = ceñisteis)
ides: ir — you go (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = vais)
ondrada: ondrar — honored, splendid (past part. fem. used as adj.; = honrada)
aya: aver — I may have (present subjunctive 1st sg.; = haya)
plazme: plazer + me — it pleases me (plaze + enclitic me; = me place)
daquí: de + aquí — from here (contraction); daquí = 'from now on'
mandada: mandar — promised, pledged; ordered (past part. fem.)
aduxier: aducir — (if) I/he shall bring (future subjunctive 1st/3rd sg., apocopated for aduxiere; = trajere)
contalda: contar — count it! (imperative contad + la with metathesis of -dl- to -ld-; = contadla)
ellos: ellos — they, them (stressed 3rd pl. masc. pronoun)
medio: medio — middle; en medio de 'in the middle of'
palaçio: palaçio — hall, palace; the main room of a house (= palacio)
rançal: rançal — a fine linen cloth (= ranzal)
tod: todo — all, the whole (apocopated before a vowel)
primer: primero — first (apocopated masc. before a noun)
colpe: colpe — blow, stroke, instance (= golpe); a tod el primer colpe 'at the very first go'
notólos: notar + los — he counted them (notó, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic los)
martino: Martino — Martín (Antolínez), with the -o form of the name (don Martino)
fablava: fablar — he was speaking (imperfect 3rd sg.; = hablaba)
mereçía: mereçer — I/he deserved (imperfect 1st/3rd sg.; = merecía); also modest 'I would deserve'
entre: entre — between, among; entre X e Y 'X and Y together'
ixieron: exir — they went out (preterite 3rd pl.; = salieron)
démosle: dar + le — let us give him (present subjunctive 1st pl. demos + enclitic le)
buscado: buscar — sought; procured, brought about (past part.)
mereçedes: mereçer — you deserve (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = merecéis)
darvos: dar + vos — to give you (infinitive + enclitic vos)
queremos: querer — we wish, we want (present 1st pl.)
fagades: fazer — you may make (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; = hagáis)
dámosvos: dar + vos — we give you (present 1st pl. damos + enclitic vos)
mereçer: mereçer — to deserve; to earn back, repay (infinitive; first half of a split future in mereçer no' lo hedes)
hedes: aver — you have (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = habéis); auxiliary of the split future, mereçer no' lo hedes 'you will repay us'
atorgar: atorgar — to grant, consent to (infinitive; = otorgar; first half of a split future)
gradeçiólo: gradeçer + lo — he thanked (him/it) (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic lo; = agradeció)
gradó: gradar — he was glad, took pleasure (preterite 3rd sg.; gradó exir 'he was glad to go out')
exir: exir — to go out, leave (infinitive; = salir)
espidiós: espedirse — he took leave (espidió + enclitic reflexive se, preterite 3rd sg.; = se despidió)
exido: exir — gone out (past part.; exido es 'has gone out', ser as perfect auxiliary)
nasco: nacer — he was born (strong preterite 3rd sg.; = nació)
reçibiólo: reçibir + lo — he received him (preterite 3rd sg. + enclitic lo; = lo recibió)
abiertos: abierto — open (masc. pl.; past part. of abrir)
venides: venir — you come (2nd pl. present, old -des ending; = venís)
vea: veer — may I/he see (present subjunctive 1st/3rd sg.; = vea)
ayades: aver — you may have (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hayáis)
vayamos: ir — let us go (present subjunctive 1st pl., exhortative; = vayamos)
san: santo — Saint (apocopated before a name; = san)
pero: Pero — Peter (San Pero = San Pedro, the saint of the monastery)
cardeña: Cardeña — San Pedro de Cardeña, the Benedictine monastery near Burgos where Ximena is lodged
veremos: veer — we shall see (future 1st pl.; = veremos)
menbrada: menbrado — prudent, sensible (fem.; lit. 'mindful', from membrar 'to bear in mind')
dalgo: de + algo — of something; fija dalgo 'daughter of something', well-born (= hidalga)
mesuraremos: mesurar — we shall measure, keep within measure (future 1st pl.); mesuraremos la posada, probably 'we shall cut our stay short' (sense uncertain)
quitaremos: quitar — we shall leave, give up (future 1st pl.; quitar el reynado 'leave the kingdom')
plazdo: plazdo — term, time limit, appointed day (= plazo)
dichas: dezir — said, spoken (past part. fem. pl.; = dichas)
cogida: coger — taken up, struck (past part. fem.; la tienda es cogida 'the tent is struck')
conpañas: conpaña — company, retinue, band of followers (pl.; = compañas)
cavalgan: cavalgar — they ride, mount (present 3rd pl.; = cabalgan)
santigua: santiguar — he crosses himself, blesses (present 3rd sg.; la cara se santigua 'crosses his face')
válanme: valer + me — may they help me (present subjunctive 3rd pl. + enclitic me; = válganme)
gloriosa: glorioso — glorious (fem.; used as address to the Virgin)
quito: quitar — I leave, give up (present 1st sg.)
ayude: ayudar — may she help (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
acorra: acorrer — may she succour, come to the aid of (present subjunctive 3rd sg.)
fiziéredes: fazer — (if) you do, should do (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; = hiciereis)
complida: complir — fulfilled, accomplished (past part. fem.; = cumplida)
mando: mandar — I promise, vow; I order (present 1st sg.)
debdo: debdo — debt, obligation (= deuda); aver en debdo 'to be bound by a vow'
faga: fazer — may I/he make, cause (present subjunctive 1st/3rd sg.; = haga); faga cantar 'have sung'
cantar: cantar — to sing; cantar missas 'to say masses' (infinitive)
spidiós: espedirse — he took leave (espidió + enclitic reflexive se, preterite 3rd sg., with e- dropped; = se despidió)
caboso: caboso — accomplished, excellent (adj., also used alone as a noun, 'the excellent one')
veré: veer — I shall see (future 1st sg.; = veré)
castigar: castigar — to instruct, advise (infinitive; castigar los he = 'I shall instruct them', split future)
abrán: aver — they will have (future 3rd pl.; = habrán); abrán a far 'they will have to do'
far: far — to do (apocopated infinitive of fazer; = hacer)
quisiere: querer — shall wish (future subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quisiere)
incal: incaler — it matters (present 3rd sg., impersonal, apocopated; a mi non m'incal 'it does not matter to me', = importa)
quiera: querer — may (it) wish, be about to (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quiera)
rayar: rayar — to dawn, to send out rays (infinitive)
tornavas: tornar + se — he turned back (tornava + enclitic reflexive se, imperfect 3rd sg.; = se tornaba)
quel: que + le — who ... him (que + enclitic/elided le)
sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure'
quieren: querer — they wish, are about to (present 3rd pl.)
crebar: crebar — to break (infinitive; = quebrar); crebar albores 'dawn to break'
sancho: Sancho — the abbot of San Pedro de Cardeña
rezaba: rezar — he was praying, reciting (imperfect 3rd sg.)
matines: matín — matins, the early-morning office of prayer (pl.; = maitines)
abuelta: abuelta — together with, at the same time as (a + vuelta; = a vuelta de)
doña: doña — lady (title; Latin domina, fem. of don)
pro: pro — worth, merit; de pro 'worthy, of good standing'
tú: tú — thou, you (2nd sg. subject pronoun; used in prayer to God)
val: valer — help! (imperative 2nd sg., apocopated for vale; = vale)

__broaden__.no: no — not (variant spelling of non) · also nos — to us (nos elided before lo: no' lo, 'to us it')
__broaden__.nos: nos — we (subject pronoun; = nosotros) · also nos — us, to us (object pronoun; atorgar nos hedes 'you will grant us')
__broaden__.y: y — and (rarer spelling of e) · also y — there (adverb, = i, Latin ibi; entraré y 'I shall enter there')
__broaden__.don: don — don, lord (honorific title) · also don — gift (noun; en don 'as a gift')
__broaden__.es: seer — it is (present 3rd sg.) · also ser as perfect auxiliary of intransitives (exido es 'has gone out') and passive auxiliary (la tienda es cogida)
__broaden__.recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand')
__broaden__.contado: contar — renowned, esteemed (past part. used as a standing epithet of the Campeador) · also of others: un Burgalés contado, 'a renowned man of Burgos' (Martín Antolínez)
__broaden__.aun: aun — even, besides · also aun — yet, still (aun vea el dia 'may I yet see the day')
__broaden__.coger: coger — to take in, shelter (here = acoger) · also coger — to take up, strike (a tent: coger la tienda)
